core_meaning.primary_meaning: Gul is a Persian-origin name meaning “Flower, rose”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Persian word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Gul corresponds to the Persian form غول (Persian گل (gol) 'flower, rose'). Its core sense is rose, flower. Gul is the Persian/Urdu گل (gol/gul) 'flower, rose' — one of the commonest name elements in Persianate and South Asian naming (as in Gulzar, Gulshan, Gulnar). The source gave غول (which is the unrelated Arabic ghūl 'ghoul') as the Arabic form; the correct form is گل. The record's 'Arabic' label is also wrong — the word is Persian.

persian.name: گل
persian.long_meaning: Gul (گل) نامی برگرفته از زبان فارسی است و معنای اصلی آن گل، گل سرخ است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

hindi.name: गुल
